# VersionRadar

Read `/AGENTS.md` before modifying this repository. It is the source of truth. Read the relevant focused skill under `.agents/skills/` for Angular, testing, security, VersionRadar scanning, Azure DevOps, or Bitbucket work.

- Keep strict TypeScript and reuse the existing Angular architecture.
- Never commit or log credentials, tokens, passwords, or `.env` content.
- Update tests when behaviour changes and run relevant type checks.
- Do not modify generated data under `src/assets/data/` without understanding its generator and synchronisation workflow.
